item.title: Cut Waste If We Must, But Don’t Cut Protection
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
The wrong health spending cuts will cost Malaysia more than they save. Don't touch primary care, emergency services, public health/communicable disease control, essential medicines, and MCH. Older Malaysians will be among the first to suffer consequences. The post Cut Waste If We Must, But Don’t Cut Protection appeared first on CodeBlue .

item.title: Dialysis, Cancer Patient Groups Oppose Health Spending Cuts
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
NKF and NCSM warn that cuts to the government's health budget may hit dialysis and cancer services. NKF, which receives substantial subsidies from MOH for kidney replacement therapy, says it may be forced to reduce screening and prevention programmes. The post Dialysis, Cancer Patient Groups Oppose Health Spending Cuts appeared first on CodeBlue .

item.title: Dzulkefly Expects 10% Cut To Health Ministry’s Budget
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Dr Dzul says he expects a cut of about 10% to MOH's RM46.5 billion budget, but maintains that "essential core services" will be protected. A 10% cut is equivalent to RM4.65 billion, much higher than the RM3 billion cut initially suggested by the Treasury. The post Dzulkefly Expects 10% Cut To Health Ministry’s Budget appeared first on CodeBlue .
